games.name: SPECTER
games.desc:
Experiments gone wrong have unleashed ghosts across the world. Explore, discover paranormal evidence, and uncover the dark secrets hidden within 15+ haunted locations.

These ghosts are extremely dangerous. Use hiding spots to your advantage, and carefully control your stamina to survive the hunt phase.

Need more help? Use the journal's FAQ section during a match, or check out our server.

⚠️ This game contains flashing lights, loud noises, and scary scenes.
⚙️ An extensive settings menu is available in the lobby! Customize your experience to your liking.
🎧 We recommend using headphones for the best experience.
🎙️ Spirit Box and the team radio feature supports voice chat!
🎵 The lobby music and ambient soundtracks used in SPECTER are original and copyright free, you are free to use them in videos!

Inspired by the horror game Phasmophobia.

games.name: Playbreak
games.desc:
This is a 1v6 asymmetrical game heavily inspired by "Project: Playtime", but with a few additions and improvements of its own, aiming to become more original over time.
Please note that this game is in BETA, nothing is final, and it should not be treated as such.
If you love the game, it'll get even better, we are currently working on the FULL release!
The entire game will be recoded, new mechanics will come, and much more!
- HOW TO PLAY -
Specialists must complete puzzles, collect toy parts, and help each other escape.
The monster must try to stop the Specialists from completing their tasks by downing them and throwing them into the feeding pit.

- IMPORTANT -
All rights belong to Mob Entertainment for their respective items, models, rigs, characters, sounds, music, and animations. I do not own them. Please support Mob Entertainment before anything else.
If you have any copyright concerns, feel free to message me, and I will gladly remove any content from the game as soon as possible.
